messages:
Michelle: opened PR #4123 for RC1 — release notes + SDK snippet update. Need review/merge before RC cutoff Thu 2026-03-26 18:00 UTC. Preview: https://deploy-preview-4123--docs.redwood.com
Jorge: quick :eyes: will take a look. Is this tied to feature flag `new-chat-routing`?
Michelle: yes — docs show how to configure routing and the sample config depends on that flag. We should version this under `v1.4-rc1` and avoid landing on main until release.
Priya: +1 on versioning. We should coordinate with release engineer — if flag is gated, merge to `release/v1.4-rc1`, not main.
Ken: SRE note: we can flip the flag in canary at 2026-03-26 16:00 UTC. If docs merge earlier, we need the snippet behind a conditional or publish only to the release branch.
Asha: QA: CI mkdocs linkcheck failing on PR — looks like an internal link to `/integrations/kms`. I can submit a tiny patch.
docs-bot: CI status: mkdocs-linkcheck failed. Preview build: https://deploy-preview-4123--docs.redwood.com/failed
Michelle: thanks @Asha — pushed a fix and added a short migration section for customers upgrading from v1.3 to v1.4.
Jorge: LGTM on content and examples. One nit: update Python SDK snippet to use `client.retry_policy` instead of `client.set_retry`.
Priya: i'm +1 on merging to the release branch once CI is green. Will approve after checks pass.
Ken: reminder: cutoff is Thu 2026-03-26 18:00 UTC. Release freeze begins 30m before. Latest safe merge time 17:30 UTC to let rollout scripts run.
Michelle: can we aim for a merge window 2026-03-26 15:00–15:30 UTC? That gives SRE time to toggle flag in canary at 16:00 and validate.
Ken: works for me.
Jorge: :thumbsup: i'll queue my final review for 15:00 and do the content+snippet pass then.
Asha: linkcheck fixed, preview successful: https://deploy-preview-4123--docs.redwood.com/ ✅
docs-bot: CI status: all checks passed. Ready to merge.
Priya: approving now. @michelle please merge to `release/v1.4-rc1` (do NOT merge to main yet).
Michelle: merging to `release/v1.4-rc1` now. won't cherry-pick to main until post-release green.
Ken: flag schedule updated in release playbook (canary flip at 16:00, gradual rollout after).
Michelle: :shipit: thanks everyone — will follow up with post-merge smoke test results and the docs version tag.
